title: HBM's Nuclear Tech Mod
subtitle: Multiblocks, chemistry, nuclear science
description: HBM's Nuclear Tech Mod is a silly soulful automation/progression tech mod
It is mainly multiblock focused, with factorio-like logistics (with some elements from satisfactory, allowing it to work in a 3d environment)
The mod adds alot of structures and environmental hazards you will find around as well whilst exploring.

rewards.title: You can press F1 on items with guides
